title: Human directs a governed change through DEVAI
summary: A human selects work, operates an authorized discipline, and uses DEVAI to sense, triage, gate, and retain evidence without delegating merge authority to the harness.

permissions_required: Repository write access appropriate to that role

preconditions: The adopter has a valid project configuration and declared stack
The human has declared a role and selected a backlog item
Authority enforcement mode is visible in doctor output

steps.action: Select a backlog item and request DEVAI sensing and triage
steps.expected_outcome: DEVAI reports current state and an explicit failure classification without mutating the plant

steps.action: Implement the selected change within the declared role and path authority
steps.expected_outcome: The change remains attributable to the human-directed session

steps.action: Run deterministic hard gates and produce evidence
steps.expected_outcome: Unsafe or incoherent state blocks; green state is reported with source-bound evidence

steps.action: Review the evidence and decide whether to merge or revise
steps.expected_outcome: Only the human authorizes repository integration

postconditions: DEVAI did not invent, dequeue, merge, push, or publish work autonomously
The disposition and relevant gate results are retained as evidence

acceptance_criteria.statement: Every mutation and integration decision is explicitly human initiated.
DEVAI blocks a failed hard gate and reports the authority boundary honestly.
